display_mode.description: Controls where Model Invaders mounts: 'auxiliary' (default; the agent streams a pill that docks the game in the Right Auxiliary Pane), 'window' (the hook opens a standalone app window on the first prompt), 'inline' (inline in chat on turn 1), 'inline-follow' (re-pinned at the bottom of each reply), 'both', or 'off'.

spawn_ufo_on_tool_use.description: Spawns a bonus 100-pt Subagent UFO labeled with the active tool name whenever PreToolUse fires.

keep_alive_on_subagents.description: When true, keeps the game unlocked when the main turn stops if background tasks or subagents are still running (fullyIdle === false). Defaults to false so the game always stops immediately when the response is done.

banner_user_markdown.description: Experimental: when true, the SessionStart banner is sent as systemMessage.metadata.user_markdown so Antigravity renders the ▶ Open Model Invaders pill inline and always visible (instead of inside a collapsed 'Hook Json SessionStart' row). Some Antigravity builds drop the entire hook result when metadata is present; turn off if no banner appears.
